parse_args_cli: parse command line arguments for SlowFast video training and testing pipeline with shard and config options
load_config_from_args: load and initialize SlowFast configuration from parsed CLI arguments and YAML config file
run_parse_args: run parse_args to get shard_id, num_shards, init_method, cfg_file, and opts from command line
test_load_config: test load_config to verify it merges YAML config file settings with command line override options
review_parse_args: review parse_args to understand the SlowFast distributed training argument parsing and default config path
